stories.headline: Should You Buy Mastercard Stock Before the Investor Update?
stories.body: Innovators are trying to capture the lucrative market that Mastercard (NYSE: MA) and its rivals now dominate.

stories.headline: The aerospace and defense trade is taking investors deeper into space, and more ETFs are up for the mission
stories.body: VettaFi's Cinthia Murphy finds more exchange-traded funds are tackling the space theme more directly as excitement over the SpaceX IPO grows.

stories.headline: Western Union Bets on Stablecoins and M&A for Growth
stories.body: Western Union is looking to stablecoins and merger and acquisition (M&A) activity for growth after a quarter in which revenue was flat due to a decline in the Americas business.
